blocking_gaps.requirement: R1_COMPLETE_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_PROPOSAL requires every archive member, including classes/resources/generated/synthetic entries and duplicate/shadow handling.

blocking_gaps.evidence: The composite binds the capture implementations and produced runtime slices but does not preserve the complete settings/included-build/buildSrc/version-catalog/lock/verification/repository/compiler-plugin/flag input universe required by the proposal.
blocking_gaps.requirement: Manifest build_inputs cannot be populated completely from the preserved artifact without consulting uncaptured bytes.

interpretation: The accepted composite remains valid candidate provenance for all slices it actually captured.
Passing r1_complete_runtime_manifest.py with placeholder, substituted or repurposed digests would be schema conformance only and would violate the reviewed completeness boundary.
No expected-manifest digest is adopted and no prepared-worker, combined-receiving, R1 permit, claim, seed, allocation or gameplay authority follows.
